about.title: About the artist
about.heading: Deep Inertia
about.body: Deep Inertia is the slow, cold-weather project of a producer who records in an unheated boathouse through the winter months. Tape loops, a detuned upright piano and field recordings of ice on the lake carry most of the weight; vocals arrive late, half-buried, and leave early. Tears of Ice, the fourth album, was finished in a single February and released without a single.
